name: record_shape
hypothesis: A declared workflow record has the required finite public fields and bounded arrays.

name: event_sequence
hypothesis: Event sequence numbers and state continuity are exactly checkable.

name: transition_legality
hypothesis: Every transition belongs to the frozen finite transition relation.

name: idempotency_consistency
hypothesis: Repeated request identifiers do not carry conflicting payload hashes.

name: attempt_budget
hypothesis: Observed attempts remain inside the declared finite retry budget.

name: retry_decision
hypothesis: Retry eligibility follows terminal state, acknowledgement and remaining budget.

name: acknowledgement_reduce
hypothesis: A finite submission stream reduces to one explicit delivery disposition.

name: duplicate_guard
hypothesis: Accepted, opaque or unresolved submissions stop duplicate sends.

name: capability_intersection
hypothesis: Requested and allowed capabilities have an exact finite intersection and denial set.

name: authority_vacancy
hypothesis: Missing action-specific authority prerequisites remain explicit vacancies.

name: rollback_reachability
hypothesis: Rollback reachability is computed only in the frozen finite state graph.

name: provenance_chain
hypothesis: Every event digest binds its predecessor and public payload exactly.

name: hook_order
hypothesis: Hook order is inspected without inferring live runtime execution.

name: start_stop_pair
hypothesis: Session start and stop observations are counted and paired explicitly.

name: claim_overlap
hypothesis: Repository-relative path and exclusive-action overlaps are finite advisory results.

name: workflow_artifact_budget
hypothesis: File and word counts are compared with declared ceilings.

name: privacy_label
hypothesis: Public synthetic records omit forbidden raw task, credential and participant fields.

name: terminal_projection
hypothesis: Three dimensionless coordinates represent a workflow profile without claiming a real system.

name: live_service_observation_gap
hypothesis: No synthetic record can establish a live service, hook or UI observation.

name: protected_authority_hold
hypothesis: External professional, legal, cultural, affected-party and Maori authority remains outside software.
